## Checklist

- [ ] All heading levels are sequential (no skipped levels)
- [ ] No `TBD`, `TODO`, or `FIXME` placeholders
- [ ] All code blocks have language identifiers
- [ ] All internal links are valid
- [ ] All images exist in `static/` folders
- [ ] Bilingual counterpart file exists (for content changes)
- [ ] Chinese files use Chinese punctuation
